data.title: Reconcile AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md: explain and fix divergent README descriptions + duplicated/conflicting content

data.body: ANSWER to 'why different': AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are complementary, not duplicate. AGENTS.md is the session-protocol/orientation hub (reading order, git sync, house rules, DESIGN.md conformance, pre-PR validation) and the file cross-tool agents read by default. CLAUDE.md is the Lattice work-tracking deep-dive that AGENTS.md points to, and the file Claude auto-loads. The README descriptions differ because the files differ. The actual bug was an ASYMMETRIC cross-reference (AGENTS->CLAUDE but not back), so Claude agents auto-loading CLAUDE.md missed AGENTS.md's house rules/conformance/validation. Fixed by adding a reverse Orientation pointer in CLAUDE.md + clarifying README.
Review: docs-only; cross-refs now symmetric; README relationship explicit; no code touched so typecheck/tests unaffected. Meets acceptance.
